## Decisions and why
- The budget is derived from a real ceiling, not taste: `additionalContext` is
  truncated at 8000 characters or 200 lines, silently. A 14200-token handoff does
  not merely cost a lot, it arrives cut in half.
- The handoff is written after compacting, never before: at 70-80% of the window
  the drafting itself can trigger the compaction it was meant to pre-empt.
- `PreCompact` was dropped. It has no model turn, so it cannot draft; `PostCompact`
  carries `compact_summary` and `Stop` has the turn.
- `memory` is the fallback for every ambiguity. An unreadable document must never
  authorise continuing work.
- Config keys and the mode enum stay English in every language; `language` only
  changes what a human reads.

## Traps
- `git status` and the freshness count must exclude `.baton/`, or baton reports
  its own files as the user's work.
- A parameter named after an imported module shadows it. `wrap(document=...)` broke
  the safe-mode fallback and no test caught it until the rename.
- Bumping the version is required for `claude plugin update` to pick up changes.
